human_summary:
The podcast features two Haileybury Almaty alumni currently studying at Yale University. Gauhar, a class of 2020 graduate, is in her fourth year studying chemical engineering and plans to work in the chemical engineering industry after graduation. She describes her academic background, including A-levels in chemistry, mathematics, biology, French, and Russian, and explains that she chose Yale for its liberal arts system, which allowed her to explore different fields before declaring a major. She also notes that she applied through early action and recalls the emotional moment of receiving her acceptance with her family.

Danat, a class of 2022 graduate, is a junior majoring in economics and is interested in pursuing a career in finance. He explains that Yale’s flexible curriculum allowed him to explore subjects such as mathematics, physics, and economics before committing to his major.
